title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Overview:

**Job Title:** Senior SQL Database Administrator  
**Experience:** 10–12 Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad (Office / Rotational)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior SQL Database Administrator with 10–12 years of experience to lead the design, optimization, and automation of enterprise-scale database systems. This role requires deep expertise in performance tuning, large database management (10TB+), and building automation frameworks that integrate on-premises and AWS environments. The ideal candidate will adopt an “infrastructure as code” mindset and drive scalable, high-performance data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Database Administration & Maintenance**

* Manage, monitor, and maintain SQL Server databases to ensure high availability, performance, and security.
* Design and support complex replication topologies to maintain data consistency across distributed environments.
* Perform regular health checks, system audits, and capacity planning.

**Performance Tuning & Optimization**

* Conduct advanced performance tuning and bottleneck analysis across CPU, memory, and storage layers (NVMe/EBS) for very large databases (VLDBs).
* Perform wait state analysis and optimize storage I/O performance.

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Design, implement, and manage SQL Server Always On Availability Groups.
* Troubleshoot high-latency transactional replication issues in high-throughput systems.
* Establish and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Develop self-service automation solutions for development teams (e.g., automated database refreshes, schema validation).
* Build and maintain cross-platform automation frameworks using PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
* Implement automated compliance checks and health monitoring for large-scale environments.

**Database Migration & Upgrades**

* Architect and execute migration strategies for large databases (10TB+) from on premises to AWS (EC2/RDS) with minimal downtime. Utilize tools and techniques such as Log Shipping, Mirroring, and AWS DMS.
* Leverage Delphix for data virtualization and masking to streamline non-production data provisioning.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Deploy and manage SQL Server databases in AWS environments, including RDS and EC2.
* Ensure adherence to cloud best practices for scalability, security, and cost optimization.

**Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Proactively monitor database performance and resolve incidents.
* Use monitoring tools such as Foglight, DataDog, CloudWatch, and Redgate.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.

**Collaboration**

* Collaborate with application development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams.
* Provide database design guidance and support development initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience as a SQL Server DBA.
* Proven experience managing large-scale databases (10TB+).
* Strong expertise in:
* SQL Server performance tuning (execution plans, indexing, query optimization)
* Always On Availability Groups
* SQL Server Replication
* Backup and recovery strategies
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Experience with Delphix (data virtualization and masking).
* Strong knowledge of AWS database services.
* Experience in database migrations and upgrades.
* Solid understanding of database security and compliance practices.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience with CommVault for backup and recovery.
* Working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL, Managed Instances).
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to translate complex technical database challenges into actionable business insights for stakeholders and provide technical mentorship to junior team members.
* Proven ability to maintain composure and lead technical resolution during high-pressure production outages and complex multi-wave cloud migrations.
* A strategic mindset focused on 'Automation First' - proactively identifying manual bottlenecks and architecting long-term scalable solutions rather than quick fixes.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
**Senior Database Administrator**

**Job Summary**

Senior Database Administrator responsible for enterprise database administration across PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, and MySQL environments. Proven experience in database installation, upgrades, patching, performance tuning, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, replication, cloud database support in Azure and AWS, security administration, automation scripting, and operational support within incident, change, and problem management frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in high-availability architecture, replication, platform engineering, security hardening, automation, incident response, and operational excellence within large-scale enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain enterprise database platforms, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server and MySQL technologies.
* Perform backup, recovery, restore validation, and capacity planning to ensure business continuity and resilience.
* Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement performance tuning and optimization across enterprise environments.
* Design and support high availability and disaster recovery solutions, including replication and failover strategies.
* Administer database security controls, including access management, encryption, auditing, and compliance support.
* Support and manage cloud-based database environments across Azure and AWS.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts for database operations, monitoring, maintenance, and deployment activities.
* Provide 24x7 on call support, Participate in incident, change and problem management processes to maintain stability and service reliability.
* Drive vulnerability remediation, configuration hardening, and compliance initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of hands-on database administration experience.
* Strong experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server administration in a highly available environment
* Strong expertise in SQL tunning, index and query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.
* Experience in administrating active/active GoldenGate Replication between multiple Data Centers.

**Technical Skills**

* Database Platforms: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL.
* Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Database Administration Tools: pgAdmin, SSMS, DBeaver, Toad, MySQL Workbench, Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM), GGSCI.
* High Availability / Disaster Recovery: Oracle Active Data Guard, MS SQL Server Always On, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication, MySQL Replication.

* Automation / Scripting: Shell scripting, Python, PowerShell, SQL scripting, Bash.
* Backup / Recovery / Migration: Oracle RMAN, Data Pump, pg\_dump, pg\_restore, mysqldump, MySQL Enterprise Backup, SQL Server Backup/Restore.
* Operating Systems: Linux, Windows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud-managed database services.
* Hands-on experience with automation using Python, Shell, or PowerShell.
* Relevant certifications from Oracle, Microsoft, or AWS.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are a fast-growing technology startup preparing new products for production. We're looking for a hands-on **Database Platform Engineer** to own our PostgreSQL databases on AWS end to end: keeping them fast, reliable and secure at high concurrency, building the data pipelines that feed them, and automating how they are deployed and changed. You'll work closely with our principal engineer and backend team, and your decisions will shape the platform as it scales.

Key responsibilities

**Database administration**

* Own PostgreSQL on AWS RDS / Aurora in production, including high availability, replication and failover.
* Design and test backup and point-in-time recovery to meet defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Tune performance using execution plans, pg\_stat\_statements and Performance Insights; manage indexes, partitions, vacuum and bloat.
* Configure RDS parameter groups and connection pooling (PgBouncer / RDS Proxy) for high-concurrency workloads.
* Plan and run zero-downtime schema changes, data migrations and major version upgrades.
* Review database designs from developers for performance, integrity and security.

**Data engineering**

* Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT, CDC) using Python, SQL and AWS services.
* Move data reliably between transactional databases, event streams and analytics stores.

**DevOps and automation**

* Provision and manage database infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate database deployments through CI/CD pipelines using Flyway or Liquibase.
* Set up monitoring, alerting and dashboards with CloudWatch and Grafana; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Enforce database security: access control, encryption, auditing and secrets management.
* Automate routine operations with Bash and Python scripts.

Must-have skills

* 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production, including databases of 1 TB or more.
* Strong experience with AWS RDS or Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, Multi-AZ, read replicas, snapshots and upgrades.
* Proven experience with backup, PITR and restore, plus performance tuning and lock troubleshooting under high concurrency.
* Experience delivering zero-downtime schema changes and data migrations.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* CI/CD for database changes (Flyway, Liquibase, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline).
* Strong SQL plus scripting in Python and Bash; comfortable on Linux.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Pay: ₹691,000.00 - ₹1,900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Experience:

* PostgreSQL: 4 years (Required)
* aws rds: 1 year (Required)
* database migration: 1 year (Required)
* Performance tuning: 3 years (Required)
* DB parameter handling: 2 years (Required)

Location:

* Hyderabad, Telangana 500050 (Required)

Work Location: In person

---------------

Analyst will also be responsible for resolving incoming telephone / email requests for technical assistance on standard commercial and proprietary applications. **About CleanHarbors**

  

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by **Mr. Alan S. McKim**.

  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company.
